manifest.name: @morehao/dsh-skills-console
manifest.description: 统一管理本地技能的安装、更新、删除与接入，让同一份技能在多个 Agent 间复用。A skill manager for DeepSeek Harness: install, update, remove, link and toggle agent skills.
manifest.author: morehao <morehao@qq.com>

scripts.check: node scripts/check-syntax.mjs && node scripts/check-cycles.mjs && npm run build && npm run check:types && node scripts/check-naming.mjs && node scripts/check-pack.mjs && node scripts/smoke-release-notes.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:host && npm run build:client

bundle.text:
# dsh-skills-console bundle patch
#
# 一个 Host half（lib/index.js）加一个 Web Client half（client.js）：
# Host 负责清单扫描 / native installer 安装更新删除 / 软链 / 订阅与更新事务；
# Client 在设置页渲染「技能控制台」（已安装 / 订阅两个 tab，可切到侧栏独立面板）。
- insert:
    - id: dsh-skills-console
      name: '@morehao/dsh-skills-console'
      config: {}

readme.text:
**简体中文** · [English](README.en.md)

[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@morehao/dsh-skills-console) [](https://github.com/morehao/dsh-skills-console/actions/workflows/check.yml) [](LICENSE)

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）的技能控制台：**安装、更新、删除、启停、共享至其他 Agent，外加一份订阅清单**。

它把本机技能收进一张清单：有哪些、从哪来、谁能用、是不是最新。要用的打开，不用的关掉；别的 Agent 需要，一键建链过去——技能本体始终只有一份。

- **一个地方管所有技能**：装好的和本机已有的技能都在同一张清单里，来源、版本、共享至哪些 Agent、更新时间一眼看清，不用去翻目录。
- **按需启停，省上下文**：暂时用不上的技能一键停用，DSH 的模型调用与 `/` 手动调用立刻看不到它，再打开就恢复；磁盘上的技能、共享关系、其他 Agent 都不受影响。
- **一份技能，多个 Agent**：多数 Agent（OpenCode、Cursor、Gemini CLI 等）直接读共享技能目录，装好即用；只认自己目录的（如 Claude Code）在面板里勾一下就能建链过去。
- **装完不是结束**：上游仓库一直在动，控制台会检查新提交，先告诉你「会影响哪些技能」，再由你决定更不更新。
- **删错还能救**：删除先进回收站保留 7 天；更新失败自动回滚上一版。

| 能力 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 清单 | 汇总本机技能，来源、版本、可见状态、共享至哪些 Agent 一处看全；共享目录里已有的技能第一次打开就自动纳入管理 |
| 安装 | 填 `owner/repo` 或 GitHub URL，先检测仓库里有哪些技能、各自做什么；可以全装，也可以只挑几个 |
| 更新 | 检查上游新提交，列出 commit 区间和受影响的技能，确认后一键更新；本地改过的技能会先要求确认 |
| 删除 | 删除前体检（不碰别人建的东西），再快照进回收站（保留 7 天） |
| 启停 | 一键开关；停用后 DSH 的模型调用与 `/` 手动调用都看不到它，其他 Agent 与磁盘文件不受影响 |
| 共享 | 只给「只读自己目录」的 Agent 建链，默认不共享；直接读共享目录的 Agent 不出现在列表里 |
| 查看 | 只读打开技能正文与文件：渲染 / 原文切换、目录树、单文件预览，外加来源、哈希与共享信息 |
| 技能简介 | 列表每行一个 ✨，点开就能看到模型写的「这个技能能做什么、什么时候用」；只发 `SKILL.md` 与文件名清单，结果缓存在本地，内容没变不重复调用 |
| 订阅 | 关注 `owner/repo` 的上游变化，只记快照、不下载技能；展开条目能看到作者原描述，也可以让模型写一段 AI 简介再决定装不装；ref / 子目录可选，不填 ref 时跟随默认分支 |
| 作用范围 | 管 user 级共享技能；暂不支持按项目启停。项目或用户目录里有同名副本时，副本仍优先可见 |

截图取自 v0.5.2 的 DSH Web 实机（深色主题）。素材都放在 [`assets/`](https://github.com/morehao/dsh-skills-console/tree/main/assets)（位图图标与界面截图），不随 npm 包发布，所以这里用绝对地址引用，GitHub 与 npm 页面都能看到。

**已安装清单**：来源、调用策略、共享的 Agent、更新状态一屏看全；顶部切「已安装 / 订阅」。

**只读查看器**：列表不动，右侧抽屉渲染 `SKILL.md`；可切原文、看文件树与信息，也能进整页阅读。

**AI 简介**：点行内 ✨，看模型概括的「能做什么、什么时候用」；和调用策略等弹窗一样居中打开，生成过就直接读本地缓存。

**订阅清单**：只记 `owner/repo` 的上游快照；展开看仓库里有几个技能、哪些已装、各自状态。

**添加订阅**：填 `owner/repo` 或 GitHub URL，ref 与子目录可空；只关注，不下载技能。

- **两个入口**：默认在 DSH 设置页的「技能控制台」分区；页头 ⚙ 里打开「侧边栏入口」，左侧栏就会出现独立面板，切换立即生效。
- **一页两 tab**：已安装 / 订阅。页头右侧是「新安装时自动共享」与「添加技能 / 添加订阅」。
- **每行五个动作**：开关（启停）、查看、更新、共享设置、删除；技能名旁的 ✨ 打开 AI 简介；窄面板下隐藏「查看」，技能名本身仍是入口。状态标签覆盖最新 / 可更新 / 安装后有改动 / 上游已移除 / 软链断裂等。
- **窄面板不跳版**：动作组按面板宽度自然换行，插件名始终完整；列表按宽度切两列；滚动只发生在列表区，切 tab、调整窗口都不会让整页翻面。
- **Agent 多了不挤**：每行最多展示 3 个，其余折成 `+n`，悬浮或聚焦即可看全。
- **找得到**：支持按名称 / 来源 / Agent 搜索，按「可更新 / 待检查 / 已停用」筛选，平铺或按 Agent 分组。
- **上游即来源**：插件的安装都来自 GitHub 仓库，来源（`owner/repo`）就是上游。只要装进来就能检查更新，不存在「无上游」这种状态；「待检查」只表示这次没拿到上游结论（限流、网络、仓库 404 等），下次检查会重试。订阅只是批量 / 定时探测的调度载体，不是「能否检测更新」的前提。

- **抽屉速览**：列表不动，右侧滑出只读抽屉；Esc / 点遮罩 / × 关闭，关闭后回到原来的筛选与滚动位置。
- **整页深读**：抽屉底部「在整页打开」切到整页阅读（正文 + 左侧目录），顶部返回条回列表。
- **三个 tab**：正文（渲染 / 原文切换，原文保留 frontmatter）、文件（目录树 + 单文件预览；`.md` 默认渲染、可切原文，其他文本直接出源码）、信息（来源、ref、commit、skillPath、内容哈希、安装 / 更新时间、共享至哪些 Agent、启停、安装后改动）。
- **只读**：没有输入框和保存按钮。更新 / 共享设置按可写状态决定是否可用；状态文件损坏时仍可查看，管理动作禁用。
- **能预览什么**：能按 UTF-8 解码的文本文件（`.md` / `.html` / `.jsx` / `.css` / `.sh` / 无扩展名脚本…）直接显示源码；单文件上限 256 KB（超出截断并提示）；图片、音视频、压缩包等二进制显示「暂不支持预览」和文件名 / 大小。

- **点开即看**：生成过的直接显示本地缓存，秒开；没生成过才出现「生成简介」按钮，点它才调模型。
- **写什么**：2–3 句能力简介——能做什么、什么时候用，并写清**怎么触发**：优先照抄 `SKILL.md` 里的触发词 / 示例请求，原文没写就按作者描述归纳成可以直接说的话（关键词或一句示例），也可以写技能名 / 斜杠命令；必要时点出关键限制；用模型自己的话概括，不是逐字翻译。
- **发什么**：`SKILL.md` 正文（超出 `maxInputBytes` 截断）与技能目录的文件名清单（最多 30 个），**不读其他文件内容**；语言跟随界面（中文 / English）。
- **缓存在本地**：`$DSH_HOME/cache/skills-console/intros.json`，按**身份**（`owner/repo/技能名`，无来源的技能用 `local/技能名`）+ 语言分开存；`SKILL.md` 内容哈希变了会提示「可能过期」，重新生成才覆盖。失败不缓存。旧版本放在 `$DSH_HOME/skills-console/intros.json` 的缓存仍会被只读读到，下次生成时写到新位置。
- **订阅与已安装共用一份**：同一个技能在订阅页生成过简介后，装到本地再点 ✨ 会直接命中（按 `owner/repo/技能名` 对齐），不再重复调用模型；同名但来自不同仓库的技能互不串。旧缓存（v4 及更早的 `技能名` / `remote:` key）升级后视为冷启动、自动重建。
- **默认模型**：优先用 `config.intro.provider/model`，没配就用 DSH 当前默认模型；同一时间只跑一个手动生成，重复点击返回「正在生成」。
- **批量生成**：已安装列表工具栏有「批量生成简介」，只让你选**生成范围**（仅缺失 / 全部重算），其余（并发、遇错继续、时长）由插件定默认值。任务在**后端**逐条执行，前端轮询进度、可随时取消；关闭页面任务仍会继续，重开后能接着看进度、或对上次未完成的任务点「继续」（不会自动续跑，避免无谓烧额度）。同一时刻只允许一个批量任务。
- **订阅候选也能看**：展开订阅后，条目行同样有 `✨ 简介`；按快照 `commit` 拉远端 `SKILL.md` 再生成，生成结果与已安装侧共用同一份缓存（按 `owner/repo/技能名`），装到本地后直接命中，不挡「安装」。展开时还会显示作者自己的 frontmatter 描述，不花额度。
- **关闭方式**：`config.intro.enabled = false`（界面隐藏 ✨ 入口）。其他可调项见「数据与配置」。

- **怎么查**：按宿主 `pluginManager.registries()` 给的 registry 计划（继承 profile 的镜像 / 私有源 / token 配置）依次问 `<registry>/<包名>/latest`（8 秒超时，只取版本号，取不到才回退官方 `registry.npmjs.org`），与本机安装的版本比较；Host 端 5 分钟缓存，连续打开不重复打网络。启动后约 20 秒会静默热身一次，不打扰你。
- **就地检查与更新**：胶囊直接显示当前状态（已是最新 / 有新版本 / 更新中 / 已更新待重启 / 检查失败），右侧按钮就地提供「检查 / 更新 / 重试」。有新版本时点「更新」→ 再点「确认」即把本插件重装到最新版（**两段确认**，防误触）。桌面端有 `pluginManager` 服务时走一键更新：HMR 开启时宿主会以 `already-installed` 拒绝覆盖同名已安装包，插件按官方更新路径先 `removeBundle` 再 `installBundle`。
- **更新后必须完全退出 DSH**：装完 **⌘Q 完全退出再打开** 才会加载新版本；只关窗口、或刷新页面都不行（Host half 在 Electron 主进程里，刷新只重载前端 bundle）。宿主返回 `restart-required` 时也是同一处置。版本判定以**磁盘已安装版本**为唯一真相（`@morehao/dsh-plugin-kit@^0.5.0`）：更新装到磁盘后胶囊即变「已更新 · 重启生效」，不会再因为进程仍是旧代码而持续报「有新版本」。
- **面板消失不是坏了**：一键更新会先卸载旧版本，面板与胶囊随之消失是宿主流程的正常一步。为避免「提示恰好渲染在已消失的面板里、用户错过」，插件在动手前把「刚点过更新」记到浏览器 `localStorage`（经共享包 `@morehao/dsh-plugin-kit/update/restore`）；重开（新进程）后面板若已回来，会弹出一个居中的**恢复提示**弹层（讲清「面板消失是正常、⌘Q 重开才生效」，并显示 from → to 两个版本号），点「关闭」收起（不自动消失；Esc 也可关）。另外客户端每次加载都会无条件注册一次设置页分区（`settings.section`）作为保命入口，保证「设置里一定找得到」；「侧栏入口」开着时只在侧栏出现、设置里不再残留一条，两者互斥、不会重复注册同一个 slot。
- **过程有日志**：`plugin.update.check` / `plugin.update.apply.start` / `plugin.update.apply`（带 `restartReason`）/ `plugin.update.apply.fail

点页头的**身份胶囊**（安装标识 `@scope/name@version`）打开「关于」弹窗，纯信息页：

- **身份**：Logo / 名称 / 版本；
- **包名**：整行可点，点一下复制完整安装标识（`@scope/name@version`），行尾短暂显示「已复制」（无剪贴板权限时提示「复制失败」）；
- **GitHub 仓库**：外链新开（`rel=noreferrer`）；`package.json` 没有可解析仓库地址时不拼地址，只显示一句提示；
- **许可**：MIT。

弹窗只读，不承载检查 / 更新（更新入口只在页头的更新胶囊里）。

插件自带下载与解压能力，**不需要预装 Node / npm / npx / git**；首次安装需要联网拉取依赖。

在 Harness 里装本地 link：

```bash
plugin_manager install_bundle(target = <本仓库绝对路径>)
```

或写进 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-skills-console
      name: '@morehao/dsh-skills-console'
```

面板出现在 DSH Web 的设置页 / 侧栏。

1. **添加技能**：点右上角「添加技能」，填 `owner/repo` 或 GitHub URL，点「检测技能」；仓库里有多个技能时勾选要装的（支持多选，默认全选，列表带每个技能的说明），只有一个会默认勾上。检测不到时可以手填技能名，留空则装仓库内全部。
2. **共享至其他 Agent**：只有「只读自己目录」的 Agent 才需要这一步（例如 Claude Code）。点行内「共享设置」勾选目标 Agent；本来就读共享目录的 Agent 不在列表里。之后新装技能默认共享至哪些 Agent，用页头「新安装时自动共享」设定（默认一个都不勾）。
3. **检查更新**：手动检查与后台自动检测是**互补**的两条路径，共用同一套判定、结论都落在已安装页的更新状态里。手动点列表头上的刷新图标即可检查、点亮「更新」或「全部更新」；后台另每 6 小时自动跑一次（复用 DSH 的 timer 服务，未装 timer 时这项静默跳过，手动检查不受影响），所以打开面板时往往已是最新。本地改过的技能更新前会先要求确认。
4. **调用策略**：点行内「自动 / 仅手动 / 完全停用」状态按钮，在居中的调用策略弹窗里切换。自动＝模型与 `/` 都能调用；仅手动＝只改 `SKILL.md` 的 `disable-model-invocation`，`/` 仍可用；完全停用＝把 `SKILL.md` 改名为 `SKILL.md.disabled` 并留 marker，恢复时回到停用前的模式。作者已在 `SKILL.md` 里声明仅手动时，chip 只读展示，不会被覆盖。停用期间更新 / 安装会被拒绝，避免文件被悄悄写回。

- **只动自己的东西**：只维护本插件创建的链接；删除前先体检，要删的链接已被换成真实目录或外来链就中止，别人的同名链接不碰也不删。
- **文件改动的边界**：自动只写插件状态；仅手动只改 frontmatter 的一行并先备份；完全停用只做改名 + marker，内容一字节不差。v3 lock、共享链接与正文都不碰；更新会重放调用策略，其余本地改动仍会先要求确认。
- **可回滚**：删除进回收站（7 天）；更新前自动备份，失败还原上一版，需要时也能手动回滚。
- **状态坏了就只读**：状态文件损坏或版本不认识时，插件降级只读、管理动作禁用，不猜结构、不自动修复。
- **不接收任意路径**：请求里的目标一律走注册表反查，共享链接只会指向共享目录下的同名技能。
- **大仓库也能更新**：带设计素材的大仓库（压缩包 50MB+）不会被大小上限卡住。
- **「仅手动」有明确入口**：可以在控制台切换，也可能由技能作者在 `SKILL.md` 里声明；作者声明时只读展示，不会被覆盖，也不会被当成异常。
- **同名副本会点名**：项目或用户目录里另有同名技能时，界面直接指出「模型看到的是另一份」，不假装可见的就是共享目录那一份。
- **限流有兜底**：公开仓库匿名可用；GitHub 配额打满时会自动换通道继续检查，也可以设置 `GITHUB_TOKEN`，把配额从 60 次/小时提到 5000 次/小时——私有仓库安装也靠它。

| 项 | 位置 |
| --- | --- |
| 技能本体 | `~/.agents/skills`（DSH 与多数 Agent 共用的技能目录） |
| 插件状态 | `$DSH_HOME/skills-console/state.json`（`DSH_SKILLS_CONSOLE_HOME` 可换根目录） |
| 备份 / 回收站 | `$DSH_HOME/skills-console/{backups,trash}`；仅手动改写的原文另存 `backups/invocation/` |
| 技能简介缓存 | `$DSH_HOME/cache/skills-console/intros.json`（可丢缓存，`DSH_SKILLS_CONSOLE_CACHE_HOME` 可换根目录；已安装技能按名字、订阅候选按 `source@commit:path`，只存生成的文本与元数据，不存 `SKILL.md` 原文） |
| 事件日志 | `$DSH_HOME/skills-console/dsh-skills-console.log`（JSONL，1MB 滚动） |

技能本体留在共享目录，共享只是建链，不搬文件。

技能简介的可调项（写在 profile / `cordis.patch.yml` 的插件 `config` 里）：

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `intro.enabled` | `true` | `false` 时界面隐藏 ✨ 入口，接口返回 501 |
| `intro.provider` / `intro.model` | 空 | 留空用 DSH 当前默认模型；两个必须同时给 |
| `intro.maxInputBytes` | `24576` | 发给模型的 `SKILL.md` 上限（8–48 KB），超出截断并在提示词里标注 |
| `intro.maxOutputTokens` | `4096` | 输出上限（96–8192）。这是防跑飞的预算，不是长度目标；推理模型的思考 token 也计入，实际会按模型自动抬高保底 |
| `intro.timeoutMs` | `60000` | 单次生成超时（5–60 秒），超时返回 504 |
简介长度由提示词里的 160 字控制，不要把 `maxOutputTokens` 当成目标长度；调小它不会省钱，只会让推理模型没有输出正文的空间。

readme.section: 给其他插件用（公共 API）
readme.text:
本插件把技能安装 / 更新能力做成稳定的包 API，其他 dsh 插件或脚本可以 `import` 复用，
**不要求启用「技能控制台」插件**，也不走 HTTP：

```js
import { createSkillsConsole } from '@morehao/dsh-skills-console/api';

const api = createSkillsConsole(); // 插件启用时复用插件实例；未启用时 headless 单写
const installed = await api.list({ names: ['git-kit', 'handoff', 'disk-cleanup'] });

`@morehao/dsh-commands` 1.0 起就用这条入口 `/skill-init`。可用方法与错误码、单写者
registry 机制、cordis 服务 `skillsConsole`、版本兼容边界见 [docs/api.md](docs/api.md)。

源码结构、测试策略与本地 `link:` 验证见 [docs/development.md](docs/development.md)；可见性、数据落点与实现边界见 [docs/internals.md](docs/internals.md)；发布流程与排障清单见 [docs/publishing.md](docs/publishing.md)。在本仓工作的 AI agent 请先读 [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)。

- 不做技能市场 / 搜索，也不接管或改写其他工具自己的 Agent 分发。
- 不编辑技能正文：查看器只读；只有「仅手动」会改 frontmatter 的 `disable-model-invocation`，「完全停用」只做改名，其它内容不碰。
- 不做文件级差异预览：只给 commit 区间与受影响技能；要看具体行，在终端跑 `git diff <from>..<to> -- <skillDir>`。
- 不做图片 / 二进制预览。
- 不做跨机器同步，不落盘任何 token。
- 不做进程级隐身：「自动」的启停只对 DSH 生效；「完全停用」会改名 `SKILL.md`，读该目录的其他 Agent 也看不到，但不会阻止外部重新写回文件。
- 不支持项目级启停：项目里的同名技能仍按 DSH 的优先级可见。
- 不接管宿主 preset 层与其他插件自带的技能源；诊断里会把它们标成盲区，而不是假装支持。

The skills console for DSH (DeepSeek Harness): **install, update, remove, toggle and share skills with other agents — plus a subscription list**.

It gathers the skills on your machine into one list: what you have, where it came from, who can use it, and whether it is up to date. Turn on what you use, turn off what you don't; when another agent needs one, link it over with a click — the skill itself always stays in one place.

- **One place for every skill**: installed skills and skills already on the machine live in the same list — source, version, shared agents and update time at a glance, no digging through directories.
- **Toggle on demand, save context**: disable a skill you don't need for now and DSH's model invocations and `/` manual invocations stop seeing it; turn it back on and it is back. Skills on disk, sharing, and other agents are untouched.
- **One skill, many agents**: most agents (OpenCode, Cursor, Gemini CLI, …) read the shared skills directory directly and work as soon as a skill is installed; ones that only read their own directory (such as Claude Code) can be linked with a single checkbox in the panel.
- **Installing is not the end**: upstream repos keep moving. The console checks for new commits, first tells you which skills are affected, and then you decide whether to update.
- **A wrong delete is recoverable**: removals go to the trash for 7 days; a failed update rolls back to the previous version.

| Install | Enter `owner/repo` or a GitHub URL; first detects which skills the repo has and what each does; install everything or pick a few |
| Update | Checks upstream commits, lists the commit range and affected skills, updates in one click after you confirm; skills with local edits ask for confirmation first |
| Remove | Pre-flight check (never touches what others created), then a snapshot into the trash (kept 7 days) |
| Toggle | One-click on/off; once disabled, neither DSH's model invocations nor `/` manual invocations see it; other agents and files on disk are unaffected |
| Share | Links only agents that read their own directory; nothing is shared by default; agents that read the shared directory directly are not listed |
| View | Open a skill's body and files read-only: rendered / raw toggle, directory tree, single-file preview, plus source, hash and sharing info |
| AI intro | A ✨ per row opens a model-written summary of what th

All assets live in [`assets/`](https://github.com/morehao/dsh-skills-console/tree/main/assets) (bitmap icons and UI screenshots) and are not published to npm, so they are referenced by absolute URL and render on both GitHub and the npm page.

**Installed list**: source, invocation policy, shared agents and update status in one screen; the top switches between "Installed" and "Subscriptions".

**Read-only viewer**: the list stays put while the right-hand drawer renders `SKILL.md`; switch to raw, browse the file tree and info, or open a full page.

**AI intro**: click the ✨ in a row for a model summary of what the skill can do and when to use it; it opens as a centered dialog like the other modals, and once generated it reads from the local cache.

- **Two entry points**: by default it lives in the "Skills Console" section of DSH settings; turn on "Sidebar entry" in the header ⚙ and a standalone panel appears in the left sidebar, effective immediately.
- **One page, two tabs**: Installed / Subscriptions. The header holds "Auto-share on install" and "Add skill / Add subscription" on the right.
- **Five actions per row**: toggle, view, update, share settings, delete; the ✨ next to a skill name opens the AI intro; "View" is hidden on narrow panels, and the skill name itself remains the entry point. Status labels cover up to date / update available / changed since install / removed upstream / broken link.
- **No layout jumps on narrow panels**: the action group wraps naturally with panel width and the plugin name always stays whole; the list switches to two columns by width; scrolling happens only in the list area, so switching tabs or resizing never flips the whole page.
- **Many agents don't crowd**: at most 3 are shown per row and the rest fold into `+n`; hover or focus reveals all.
- **Findable**: search by name / source / agent, filter by "updates / not checked / disabled", view flat or grouped by agent.

While managing skills you may want to know "what does this skill say, and is it worth keeping" — click the skill name or "View" on the row:

- **Drawer quick look**: the list stays put and a read-only drawer slides in from the right; close it with Esc / the overlay / ×, and you return to the previous filter and scroll position.
- **Full page for a deep read**: "Open as page" at the bottom of the drawer switches to a full page (body + contents on the left), with a top bar to go back to the list.
- **Three tabs**: Content (rendered / raw toggle; raw keeps the frontmatter), Files (directory tree + single-file preview; `.md` renders by default and can switch to raw, other text shows its source directly), Info (source, ref, commit, skillPath, content hash, install / update time, shared agents, enabled state, changes since install).
- **Read-only**: no inputs and no save button. Update / share settings are enabled depending on writability; when the state file is corrupt you can still view, but management actions are disabled.
- **What can be previewed**: text files that decode as UTF-8 (`.md` / `.html` / `.jsx` / `.css` / `.sh` / extension-less scripts…) show their source directly; the per-file cap is 256 KB (longer content is truncated with a notice); images, audio/video, archives and other binaries show "Preview not support
Some skills only have an English description, and some titles alone don't tell you what they do. Every installed row has a `✨ Intro` next to the skill name:

- **Open and read**: generated intros load from the local cache and open instantly; only when there is none does a "Generate intro" button appear, and only clicking it calls the model.
- **What it writes**: a 2–3 sentence capability summary — what it does, when to use it, and **how to trigger it**: trigger words / example requests copied from the `SKILL.md` when present, otherwise 2–4 keywords (or one example request) users can literally say, or the invocation itself (skill name / slash command); key limitations when needed; in the model's own words, not a word-for-word translation.
- **What it sends**: the `SKILL.md` body (truncated beyond `maxInputBytes`) and the list of file names in the skill directory (up to 30); **no other file contents are read**; the language follows the UI (Chinese / English).

readme.section: Check and update the plugin itself
readme.text: An **inline update capsule** next to the identity capsule in the page header checks and updates *Skills Console itself*. This is a different axis from skill updates — it checks this plugin's own npm releases:

readme.section: Check and update the plugin itself
readme.text:
- **How it checks**: follows the registry plan from the host's `pluginManager.registries()` (inheriting the profile's mirror / private source / token config) and asks `<registry>/<package>/latest` in turn (8s timeout, version only; falls back to the official `registry.npmjs.org` only if none answer), then compares with the installed version; the host caches for 5 minutes so repeated opens don't hit the network. About 20 seconds after startup it warms the cache once, silently.
- **Check and update in place**: the capsule shows the current state (up to date / update available / updating / updated-restart-pending / check failed), and its button offers "Check / Update / Retry" right there. When a new version exists, click "Update" then "Confirm" to reinstall to the latest (a **two-step confirmation** to prevent misclicks). On desktop with the `pluginManager` service it does a one-click update: with HMR the host refuses to overwrite an installed package by name with `already-installed`, so the plugin follows the official update path (`removeBundle` then `installBundle`).
- **A full quit is required afterwards**: **fully quit DSH (⌘Q) and reopen** to load the new version; closing the win
Click the **identity chip** in the header (the install spec `@scope/name@version`) to open the About dialog — a read-only info page:
The dialog is read-only and does not host check/update actions (those live only in the header's update capsule).

The plugin ships its own download and extraction code: **no Node / npm / npx / git required beforehand**; the first install needs network access to fetch dependencies.

Install a local link inside Harness:

```bash
plugin_manager install_bundle(target = <absolute path to this repo>)
```

Or add it to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-skills-console
      name: '@morehao/dsh-skills-console'
```

The panel shows up in DSH Web's settings page / sidebar.

1. **Add skill**: click "Add skill" in the top right, enter `owner/repo` or a GitHub URL, then click "Detect"; when the repo has several skills, tick the ones to install (multi-select, all selected by default, each with its description), and a single skill is selected automatically. If nothing is detected you can type skill names by hand; leaving them empty installs everything in the repo.
2. **Share with other agents**: only needed for agents that read their own directory (for example Claude Code). Click "Share settings" on a row and tick the target agents; agents that already read the shared directory are not listed. To choose which agents new installs are shared with by default, use "Auto-share on install" in the header (nothing is ticked by default).
3. **Check for updates**: manual checks and the background auto-check are **complementary** paths sharing the same verdict — both land in the installed view's update status. Click the refresh icon in the list header to check now, light up "Update", or "Update all"; the background also runs a check every 6 hours (reusing DSH's timer service, which is silently skipped when unavailable — manual checks are unaffected), so the panel is

- **Only touch what is ours**: the plugin maintains only the links it created; it runs a pre-flight check before deleting and aborts if a link to remove has become a real directory or a foreign link; same-named links created by others are never touched or removed.
- **Where file changes stop**: Auto only writes plugin state; Manual only changes one frontmatter line, with a backup first; Fully disabled only renames + writes a marker, leaving the content byte-for-byte identical. The v3 lock, shared links and the body are never touched; updates replay the invocation policy and still ask for confirmation for other local changes.
- **Rollback included**: removals go to the trash (7 days); every update is backed up first, restores the previous version on failure, and can be rolled back manually when needed.
- **Read-only when state is bad**: if the state file is corrupt or its version is unknown, the plugin degrades to read-only, management actions are disabled, and it neither guesses the structure nor auto-repairs.
- **No arbitrary paths**: targets in requests are always resolved through the registry; shared links only ever point to the same-named skill under the shared directory.
- **B

| Item | Location |
| --- | --- |
| Skill itself | `~/.agents/skills` (the skills directory shared by DSH and most agents) |
| Plugin state | `$DSH_HOME/skills-console/state.json` (`DSH_SKILLS_CONSOLE_HOME` changes the root) |
| Backups / trash | `$DSH_HOME/skills-console/{backups,trash}`; originals rewritten by Manual only are kept separately in `backups/invocation/` |
| AI intro cache | `$DSH_HOME/cache/skills-console/intros.json` (disposable cache; `DSH_SKILLS_CONSOLE_CACHE_HOME` changes the root; installed skills by name, subscription candidates by `source@commit:path`; only the generated text and metadata, never the `SKILL.md` body) |
| Event log | `$DSH_HOME/skills-console/dsh-skills-console.log` (JSONL, rotates at 1 MB) |

The skill itself stays in the shared directory; sharing only creates links and never moves files.

AI intro settings (in the plugin `config` of the profile / `cordis.patch.yml`):

| Key | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `intro.enabled` | `true` | `false` hides the ✨ entry and the API returns 501 |
| `intro.provider` / `intro.model` | empty | empty uses DSH's current default model; both must be set together |
| `intro.maxInputBytes` | `24576` | cap on the `SKILL.md` sent to the model (8–48 KB); longer input is truncated and marked in the prompt |
| `intro.maxOutputTokens` | `4096` | output ceiling (96–8192). This is a runaway guard, not a length target; reasoning tokens count toward it, and the effective floor is raised per model |
| `intro.timeoutMs` | `60000` | per-generation timeout (5–60 s); timeouts return 504 |

The intro length is controlled by the 160-character prompt target. Do not treat `maxOutputTokens` as a length target; lowering it does not save cost, it only leaves a reasoning model no room for visible text.

`@morehao/dsh-commands` 1.0 uses this entry for `/skill-init`. See [docs/api.md](docs/api.md) for
methods and error codes, the single-writer registry, the optional `skillsConsole` cordis service, and
versioning boundaries.

Source layout, test strategy and local `link:` verification are in [docs/development.md](docs/development.md); visibility, data placement and implementation boundaries in [docs/internals.md](docs/internals.md); the release process and troubleshooting checklist in [docs/publishing.md](docs/publishing.md). AI agents working in this repo should read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) first.

- No skill marketplace / search, and no taking over or rewriting other tools' own agent distribution.
- No editing skill bodies: the viewer is read-only; only "Manual only" touches the `disable-model-invocation` frontmatter key, and "Fully disabled" only renames files — nothing else.
- No file-level diff preview: only commit ranges and affected skills; to inspect individual lines, run `git diff <from>..<to> -- <skillDir>` in a terminal.
- No image / binary preview.
- No cross-machine sync, and no token is ever written to disk.
- No process-level hiding: toggling in Auto only affects DSH; Fully disabled renames `SKILL.md`, so other agents that read that directory can't see it either, but it does not prevent external writes from putting the file back.
- No project-level toggling: same-named skills in projects stay visible per DSH's precedence.
- No taking over the host preset layer or skill sources bundled with other plugins; diagnostics mark them as blind spots rather than pretending to support them.
